subject: hours of the day, qwindow function, etc for working x non-working hours

messages.author: 8f4728e5add9f695
messages.subject: hours of the day, qwindow function, etc for working x non-working hours
parts:
Hi all,

 

For a specific with study with workers, we are trying to estimate PA metrics (MVPA, ENMO, etc) during working and non-working hours.

 

However, there is huge variability in the working hours across our sample, even within participants. For example, one participant might have his/her shift from 8 am to 1 pm on Monday, from 10 am to 6:30 pm on Tuesday and so on…there is no standard at all.

 

It does not seem very logical, but I am considering to run GGIR using qwindow=c(seq(0,24,by=1)), generate a binary variable to classify each hour as a ‘working hour’ (yes/no) for each participant, and then collapse average of the PA metrics by participants and working x nonworking hours.

 

I wonder whether have anyone faced this issue when working with GGIR and would suggest an alternative approach.

 

Thanks in advance

 

Regards,

 

Gregore
